note: The single source of scope for the Gate F replay. Both scripts/replay_workloads.py and scripts/compare_replay.py consume this; neither keeps its own list. Run 31278210299 swept derivative order 4, which the v0.38b confirmatory freeze explicitly disclaims -- five of its seven cross-platform disagreements were at d=4, measured against a bound that was never established.

exploratory_policy.label: outside_frozen_scope
exploratory_policy.rationale: Retained as exploratory evidence because deleting it would discard a real measurement. Marked so it can never be read as gate evidence.

runner_constraint: macOS/arm64 has no CPython 3.12.11 or later in the actions/python-versions manifest; 3.12.11-13 are Linux-only. The originally specified 2x2 corner is not constructible on hosted runners and no re-run will produce it.

primary.name: scaled_difference
primary.rationale: Stable near the numerical floor. Every tolerance_numeric row carries reference_scale, defined as the characteristic magnitude of the quantity over its domain -- the same definition v0.38d froze.

secondary.name: relative_between_errors
secondary.rationale: Retained as a diagnostic. It produced the 2.478e-01 headline in run 31278210299 from two absolute errors of 3.0e-06 and 4.0e-06.

tolerances.note: Frozen in docs/design/v0_38_gate_f_amended_freeze.md section 4, DERIVED from IEEE-754 accumulation bounds rather than read off the pilot. Run 31278210299's in-scope worst of 1.014e-10 sits ~100x inside the cross-platform bound and is corroboration, not the derivation.
tolerances.cross_platform_derivation: n*eps*scale at n=13 (2.9e-15), amplified by a conservative 1e6 stencil condition bound at spacing ratio 1e8
tolerances.patch_drift_derivation: same platform/arch/libm/BLAS; a CPython patch changes no floating-point semantics, so bitwise identity is the correct expectation and any nonzero tolerance would accept a real regression

family_note: Declared PER WORKLOAD, not derived from a name prefix. fornberg_fn_12_uniform_spacing_ratio shares the fornberg prefix and measures the GRID's spacing ratio, which carries no derivative order; deriv_ref_none_kind likewise. A prefix heuristic mislabels both, and prefix-derived semantics is the defect class this whole correction is about.

row_counts.note: Derived from the expected-row manifest, reported for review. F-3 asserts SET EQUALITY against that manifest, never these integers -- a count check passes on the wrong 229 rows.
row_counts.superseded_reason: included ten d=4 rows carrying derivative_order null
